candidate.title: Burrard Station elevator closes for replacement

evidence.readerImpact: SkyTrain riders who need elevator access at Burrard Station can plan the Granville Station or #5 bus detour before travelling downtown.
evidence.freshnessEvidence: TransLink says Burrard Station elevator replacement starts July 21, 2026 and lasts until spring 2027.
evidence.uniqueAngleEvidence: Existing Trends Today transit articles cover fares, FIFA transit, and Coquitlam road work, not Burrard Station accessible detours.
evidence.commercialFitReason: Accessible transit detours serve recurring commuter and downtown trip-planning intent, which may support contextual local-service ads; page views, ad revenue, RPM, and sponsor demand remain unavailable.
